t: Beloved Seattle chef turns Salare restaurant into relief center for restaurant workers
s: March 31, 2020 - While Salare is formerly a contemporary space doling out all manner of local meats and creative veggie dishes to the Ravenna neighborhood, it is now a community kitchen serving hundreds of free to-go meals for restaurant workers who have been laid off or experienced a significant reduction in hours as a result of the novel coronavirus’ community impact.
